name: Repeated defects from one seam reset to design

turns.user: Two accepted post-fix findings came from the same semantic seam in one source-to-output transform. A teammate suggests adding a third reviewer. State the next workflow step.

rubric: The assistant freezes production edits and stops the patch and re-review loop.
It returns to designing-changes to write the source-to-output invariant and enumerate the relevant dimensions and pairwise compositions.
It approves the contract before another implementation attempt.
A third reviewer is not the default response, because more seats over the same oracle repeat the same blind spot.
